thread:
Maria Chen: Quick UX heads-up — our in-product docs panel uses the term 'route' in the Model page but the Console nav and API docs say 'endpoint'. That mismatch is causing confusion in the onboarding checklist. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/ux-snap-03 :warning:
Samir Patel: ah yea i've seen that. where exactly? can you paste the copy?
Maria Chen: On Models > Serve > 'Create new route' (button label) vs Console > API Access shows 'endpoint URL'. Also the inline help card says 'Deploy endpoint' — three different strings for same concept.
Jessica (Design): thanks — agreed we should standardize. propose we keep 'endpoint' as primary term (matches docs & market), use 'route' only in infra contexts. can draft microcopy.
Alex (DevEx): fwiw the current sidecar docs panel is wired to the page slug, so changing the label will need a small mapping in devex middleware. not hard but requires a migration for saved links.
Evan (A11y): accessibility note — whichever label we pick, update aria-label and the anchor text used for the help toggle. Right now the help toggle reads "Help" but the labelled region doesn't include the page context. keyboard users lose context. recommend: aria-labelledby="help-{page-slug}-title" on the flyout.
Jessica (Design): good call Evan. also let's avoid sentence-casing inconsistently — e.g., 'Deploy endpoint' vs 'Create new route' — choose either Title Case for CTAs and sentence case for descriptions. my vote: Title Case for buttons, sentence case for body.
Samir Patel: can we add a cross-link from the panel to the Console API docs? a single canonical URL would solve the 'which doc is correct' problem.
Maria Chen: yes, add a "Read canonical docs" link at top of panel pointing to /docs/api/endpoints (open in new tab). add small external link icon.
Alex (DevEx): note: link must include &utm=console-help so analytics show traffic. i'll handle mapping + utm.
Jessica (Design): i'll send a short copy PR: change button -> "Create endpoint", panel heading -> "Endpoint docs", body -> "Use endpoints to route traffic to model versions..." include microcopy for external link.
Evan (A11y): also request: ensure focus trap in panel works, focus return goes back to the original button, and that the link has descriptive text (avoid 'click here').
kudos-bot: :thumbsup: 1 reaction to Jessica (Design)'s message
Maria Chen: action items: Jessica to PR microcopy, Alex to update mapping + utm, Evan to sign off on aria/focus behavior. Samir to add cross-link acceptance criteria. i'll open a tiny RFC doc and tag #console for final signoff.
Samir Patel: sounds good. timeline?
Jessica (Design): aiming for small PR by EOD Friday.
Alex (DevEx): i'll schedule a 30min sync Mon to coordinate migration and QA.
Evan (A11y): i'll do a quick keyboard/voiceover pass after merge.
Maria Chen: perfect — thanks everyone :pray:
